instruction: Create a custom GRUB menu entry that chainloads Windows
output:
cat >> /etc/grub.d/40_custom <<'EOF'
menuentry "Windows 10" {
  insmod ntfs
  insmod chain
  set root=(hd0,1)
  chainloader +1
}
EOF
update-grub

instruction: Create a GRUB menuentry for a custom ISO boot
output:
cat >> /etc/grub.d/40_custom <<'EOF'
menuentry "SystemRescue" {
  set isofile=/boot/systemrescue.iso
  loopback loop \$isofile
  linux (loop)/sysresccd/boot/vmlinuz archisobasedir=sysresccd img_dev=/dev/sda1 img_loop=\$isofile
  initrd (loop)/sysresccd/boot/sysresccd.img
}
EOF
update-grub
